hooks.name: Frozen contract guard (save)
hooks.description: When frontend/src/types/trace.ts is saved, warn that the FROZEN shared contract changed and run npm run typecheck.

action.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/frontend" || exit 1; msg="WARNING: frontend/src/types/trace.ts (the FROZEN shared contract) was changed. Only the integrator may change it, and every workstream depends on it. Review with: git diff -- frontend/src/types/trace.ts"; echo "$msg"; echo "$msg" >&2; out=$(npm run typecheck 2>&1); code=$?; echo "$out" | tail -30; if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then echo "typecheck FAILED (exit $code) after contract change" >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "typecheck passed"
